# CRASH Lab

> Centre for Responsible Autonomous Systems in Healthcare
> Ashoka University, Sonipat, Haryana, India

CRASH Lab is an interdisciplinary research lab at Ashoka University working
at the intersection of clinical medicine, frontier AI, and evaluation science.
Founded in April 2025 by Dr. Suvrankar Datta, the lab focuses on benchmarking,
clinical AI validation, and healthcare data infrastructure for Indian settings.

## What We Do

CRASH Lab builds rigorous evaluation frameworks for AI systems operating in
healthcare — specifically radiology and diagnostic imaging. Our flagship benchmark,
Radiology's Last Exam (RadLE), revealed a 53-point performance gap between
frontier multimodal AI models and expert radiologists at RSNA 2025.

## Research Areas

- Radiology AI Benchmarks
- Clinical AI Validation (India-specific)
- Autonomous Radiology Report Generation
- Healthcare Data Infrastructure (federated, privacy-preserving)
- Healthcare AI Governance and Accountability

## Key Results

- RadLE: Expert radiologists 83%, best AI 57%, trainees 45%, GPT-5 Thinking 30%
- #1 Indian lab by AI abstracts at RSNA 2025
- 15+ papers in under 8 months from founding (April 2025)
